ownerStandingAuthorization.condition: all required tests and current mandatory publication gates pass

remoteJoiningReadiness.rule: Read the ledger; never infer readiness from PR count, stage count, WEC or visible actions.

starter.versionReason: MINOR: later standing owner merge/deploy authorization materially changes publication behavior while preserving every existing safety gate.

startupPrecedence: Newest versioned START_NEXT_SESSION file + this capsule + fixed owner authorization/RJR/WEC locks supersede older read-everything preload lists only for startup context loading; current verified source, security/recovery rules and later owner instructions remain authoritative.

retrievalStrategy.optimizationObjective: minimize startup context cost and tool latency subject to zero increase in missed critical security, recovery, authority or publication context

knownRejectedRoutes: Do not retry the PR #114 non-fast-forward update_ref route; contents writes worked and rejected attempts changed no state.

versionPolicy: PATCH fixes/hardening; MINOR product features; MAJOR breaking changes; provider/dormant evidence alone does not bump runtime identity
starterVersionPolicy: independent from app version; PATCH ordinary WEC=100 checkpoint, MINOR backward-compatible material startup-protocol improvement, MAJOR breaking startup-contract redesign
wec100PackagingRule: At every Handoff proximity 100% checkpoint generate a complete successor handoff in root plus byte-identical project-documents/handoffs mirror, generate a new versioned START_NEXT_SESSION file in root plus byte-identical project-documents/session-starts mirror, refresh capsule/graph/learning state as needed, write the final transition-prepared WEC seal as the last PR-branch mutation, validate that sealed exact head without further branch mutation, then use standing owner authorization to merge/deploy when all gates pass.
adaptiveLearningRule: Collect lightweight retrieval usefulness outcomes. Deterministic mandatory locks always win. Evaluate a supervised ranking model only after at least 20 materially distinct labeled sessions and only if held-out startup simulations reduce context cost without missed-critical-context regression.
liveFirstRule: Current source, live GitHub state, provider state, deployed site and later owner instructions override this capsule and all handoffs.
